item.text:
**7B.5 Shehbaz Sharif (2024)**
Overall read: mixed, leaning negative. I found real competence-signaling appointments and some anti-patronage reforms, but the cabinet was still heavily shaped by Sharif-family loyalists and long-time political insiders, and Sharif kept hands-on control over key coordination.

**Accepted claims**
- **Pakistan PM to choose banker Aurangzeb as finance minister, sources say** | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-03-11 | https://theprint.in/world/pakistan-pm-to-choose-banker-aurangzeb-as-finance-minister-sources-say/1996592/ | Sharif chose Muhammad Aurangzeb, a career banker, for the finance portfolio instead of a party loyalist, which is strong evidence for competence-seeking staffing. | QIDs: 7B.5, 7B.3, 7B.4
- **PM forms new economic advisory council without Dar, Aurangzeb** | The News | 2024-05-19 | https://www.thenews.com.pk/print/1190715-pm-forms-new-economic-advisory-council-without-dar-aurangzeb | Sharif created a council of economists, technocrats, and business figures to guide policy, indicating some reliance on expertise rather than pure patronage. | QIDs: 7B.5, 7B.3, 7B.4
- **PM Shehbaz directs full digitalization of social welfare payments under BISP** | APP | 2024-03-18 | https://www.app.com.pk/national/pm-shehbaz-directs-full-digitalization-of-social-welfare-payments-under-bisp/ | Moving BISP payments to digital wallets was framed as reducing leakage, delay, and discretion, which cuts against loyalty-based distribution. | QIDs: 7B.5, 7B.4, 7B.3
- **Govt unveils broader privatisation plan for state-owned enterprises** | Reuters via Dawn | 2024-05-14 | https://www.dawn.com/news/1833439/govt-unveils-broader-privatisation-plan-for-state-owned-enterprises | Sharif said most state-owned firms should be privatized, a pro-competition move that reduces state rents and patronage space. | QIDs: 7B.5, 7B.4, 7B.3
- **New blood joins old guard in federal cabinet** | Dawn | 2024-03-12 | https://www.dawn.com/news/amp/1820930 | The cabinet mixed one technocrat with many old-guard politicians, showing the staffing model was not a clean meritocratic break. | QIDs: 7B.5
- **Who are the members of PM Sharif’s new cabinet?** | Arab News PK | 2024-03-12 | https://www.arabnews.pk/node/2474906/pakistan | This account describes the cabinet as including Sharif-family loyalists alongside veteran politicians and former ministers, which supports a patronage-style reading. | QIDs: 7B.5
- **Nawaz busy selecting cabinet as Khawaja Asif sees PPP-‘N’ govt** | Dawn | 2024-02-19 | https://www.dawn.com/news/1815365/nawaz-busy-selecting-cabinet-as-khawaja-asif-sees-ppp-n-govt | Dawn reported Nawaz Sharif was actively involved behind the scenes in cabinet selection, which is indirect evidence of family influence over appointments. | QIDs: 7B.5, 7B.4
- **Sharif retained direct control over a key economic coordination body** | Dawn | 2024-06-15 | https://www.dawn.com/news/1839967 | Sharif kept direct control over ECNEC rather than fully delegating to the technocratic finance minister, suggesting continued personalization of power. | QIDs: 7B.5, 7B.3

**Search gap**
- I did not find a reliable 2024 source proving a fresh, specific enrichment event, hidden contract, or direct office-linked payoff for Sharif or close family.
- The strongest negative evidence is indirect: cabinet composition, behind-the-scenes family involvement, and continued PM-centered control over key economic decisions.
